summary_en: This Scientific Data paper introduces OpenQPAIData, a benchmark dataset built from 30 tissue-mimicking phantoms measured on three photoacoustic systems (MSOT InVision, TROPUS, and SVOT). It provides raw signals, reconstructed images, annotations, and matched optical-property reference maps, making it a useful experimental benchmark for quantitative photoacoustic reconstruction and validation.

summary_en: The paper presents a modular design for ultralow-molecular-weight NIR-II photoacoustic dyes whose biomarker-triggered conjugation transition produces near-zero background in the off state and strong 1064-nm signal after activation. The authors demonstrate an 89.8-fold signal enhancement and high-fidelity in vivo molecular imaging, including blinded early-stage hepatotoxicity detection in mice.
